title: LinkingBook
description: Teleport between dimensions using a special Linking Book.
body:
[![AshCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75887d69106ed9eb2dd595176121f279523f184_0.webp)](https://www.ashcraft.cz/)

The Linking Book plugin introduces a unique way for players to teleport between different dimensions in Minecraft. This plugin allows players to craft a special book that records their exact location, including coordinates and dimension information. When used, the book teleports the player back to its recorded location—unless they are already in the same dimension, in which case they will receive a configurable message preventing its use. [Here is a detailed breakdown of the plugin’s features and functionality.](https://ashsource.ashkiano.com/resource-detail/70)
